action.sql: SELECT p.period, SUM(g.credit - g.debit) AS revenue, (SUM(g.credit - g.debit) - LAG(SUM(g.credit - g.debit)) OVER (ORDER BY p.period)) * 100.0 / LAG(SUM(g.credit - g.debit)) OVER (ORDER BY p.period) AS pct_change FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id JOIN periods p ON g.period = p.period WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period IN ('2026-04', '2026-05') GROUP BY p.period ORDER BY p.period
